scope: TT008 task knowledge, computational work and post hoc calibration/discrimination presentation.
chronology_limit: Procedural ordering under a shared filesystem, not independent custody; no new native-array or dynamics audit.
presentation_selection: All 4096 records; candidate and two registered primary rivals; all/current-failing/current-passing groups. Ten equal-width probability bins on [0,1], empty bins omitted. No fitting or recalibration.
analysis_scope: The pass/fail Brier contributions are prespecified descriptive strata. Reliability and AUC presentation is post hoc; no new inferential claims or primary gates.
